unit_attributes.statement: Review notice (RN) means a written request for missing records.
Service receipt (SR) means an acknowledgement that records were received, and it is not an approval.
Applicants must return the RN within ten days unless a reviewer extends the deadline.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Unless a reviewer extends the deadline

unit_attributes.statement: Reviewers may extend the deadline to return the RN by five days only with a supervisor's approval.
Clerks must issue an SR when an RN is received.
A supervisor's name appears on the RN.
You must keep a copy of the SR.
Files must be retained for two years.
Storage may be unavailable during maintenance.
XYZ is an external reference code whose meaning is not supplied here.
